preconditions.description: The integer k must be between 2 and 12 inclusive.
The length of the array a must be equal to 2^k.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i < 2**k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements of the array a must be non-negative integers less than 2^k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Fou' if not any(p_i ^ q_i == a_i for i in range(2**k)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutations p and q exist, output 'Fou'.
If valid permutations p and q exist, output 'Shi' and ensure both p and q contain distinct integers from 0 to 2^k-1.

postconditions.expression: all(p[i] ^ q[i] == a[i] for i in range(2**k))
postconditions.description: For all indices i, the XOR of p_i and q_i must equal a_i.
